stem.text: A number of identical springs are joined in four arrangements.
Which arrangement has the same spring constant as a single spring?

A.alt: Single spring hanging from a horizontal support, with a load box at its lower end.

B.alt: Two springs side by side hanging from a horizontal support, with a load box below them.

C.alt: Two columns of springs hanging from a horizontal support, each column made of two springs joined end to end, with a load box below.

D.alt: Two springs side by side above a horizontal bar, with a single spring below the bar and a load box at its lower end.
